title: Browns' Todd Monken cautions 'slippery slope' of adding Brendan Sorsby

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Browns' Todd Monken cautions 'slippery slope' of adding Brendan Sorsby
sources.description: Brendan Sorsby could end up in the NFL supplemental draft, but Browns coach Todd Monken doesn't like the idea of adding him amid his gambling case.
